target.title: feat: add poll unvote updates
target.body:
## Summary
- add bridge action for native poll unvote updates
- expose `imsg poll unvote`
- expose JSON-RPC `polls.unvote` plus existing-style aliases
- fix outgoing Polls creation payloads to keep `item.title` empty, matching native Messages payloads so options render as real poll choices
- fix poll vote/unvote mutation payloads to use native minimal Polls envelopes, native `Sent a vote` summary metadata, and empty `votes: []` for unvote
- add status selector reporting, docs, and command/RPC coverage
- remove the unproven add-option surface from this PR; it needs a separate follow-up after visual append behavior is proven

## Redacted proof
Proof collected on lobster with branch-local artifacts from `feat/poll-unvote-add-option` and freshly relaunched injected Messages.app sessions. Raw logs are kept local because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, handles, and participant identifiers.

- `main` head: `c541bea2828f773e85588d0598ed3565140736f2`
- branch head after reviewer fix: `9b1dfe3`
- scope-fix proof directory: `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/162-poll-unvote-add-option/scope-fix-20260708-204535`
- reviewer fix: empty-vote rows (`votes: []`) now count as poll payload evidence even when `balloon_bundle_id` is `NULL`; regression coverage added for direct history and watcher-style reads
- before on `main`: `make build` passed; `imsg poll` help listed only `send|vote`; completions search for `poll unvote` and `polls.unvote` returned no matches
- fixed creation payload proof: archived outgoing poll payload has `item.title == ""`, `src=p&c=2`, and options in the payload; user confirmed the Messages UI rendered real options instead of an empty option shell
- fixed vote proof: user confirmed `poll vote` selected the option with the native avatar-style marker, not only a filled circle; notification text was correct (`Lobster sent a vote`)
- fixed unvote proof: native/manual comparison showed Apple unvote sends a minimal Polls envelope with `votes: []`; patched `poll unvote` used the same shape, and user confirmed the avatar/selection cleared visually
- vote/unvote payload proof: unvote row payload was 530 bytes with `votes: []`; summary was 201 bytes with `amc=9`, `enc=true`, `amd=Polls`, `ams=Sent a vote`, and the Polls balloon bundle identifier, matching native vote/unvote rows
- history readback: fixed unvote decoded as `kind=vote`, `event=imessage.poll.voted`, empty `votes`, and original poll GUID preserved
- after command/RPC surface: completions include `imsg poll unvote`; status reports `poll.unvote`, `polls.unvote`, and `messages.poll.unvote`
- add-option split-out: visual append was not proven, so this PR no longer advertises `poll add-option` or `polls.addOption`

## Verification
- `make build` ✅ after the scope fix
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅ as the first phase of `make lint`
- `make lint` ⚠️ blocked locally on lobster by SwiftLint/SourceKit: `Loading sourcekitdInProc.framework/Versions/A/sourcekitdInProc failed`
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before project tests run on this host: `Tests/IMsgCoreTests/BridgeHelperLocatorTests.swift:2:8: error: no such module 'Testing'`
- GitHub CI pending for `9b1dfe3`; previous scoped head `b693285` was green
